title: Gold Stocks Push S&P/TSX to Record on Greenland Tensions
text: Iamgold Corp. led the index after releasing better-than-expected preliminary production figures.  Despite the gains, concerns linger that Canada may be subject to additional US tariffs if the country sends troops to Greenland.  “If Canada is treated in the same vein as it seems Trump has threatened this group of European countries, you could anticipate the same threat to come to Canada,” Macquarie Group economist David Doyle said in an interview with BNN Bloomberg Television.
